> 第5章 太太去出差了（第1页）
郁默勋和容辞这些年确实很少见面。
可仅仅几面，郁默勋也能看得出现在的她，和当年的意气风发相差甚远。
想起当年的容辞，他做梦也没想到自卑一词居然有一天会出现在容辞身上。
容辞和封庭深的婚姻生活郁默勋知道得不多。
他心里有了猜测，但没明说，只是很认真的跟她说：“落后一时没关系，你的能力和天赋，不是一般天才可比拟的，小辞，只要你还有心走这条路，现在重新开始也是来得及的。”
“你别忘记了，你是老师教学生涯里，最满意的一个学生。”
容辞听着，笑了：“老师要是听了这话，只怕会嗤之以鼻，说他是被迫的在矮子里挑高个。”
想起昔日儒雅又毒舌的老师，容辞笑容淡了些：“我刚才在新闻里看到老师也回来参加庆典了，他老人家还好吗？”
“挺好的，就是我们这帮老是丢他脸的学生三不五时的出现在他面前，让他感到非常厌烦。”
容辞笑了出来，心里不由怀念起当年在恩师下面天天被摁着写论文的日子。
容辞握着茶杯的手一紧，深吸一口气后点头：“好。”
她因为爱封庭深已经丢弃了自己的理想六七年了。
她离开了六七年，要追赶起来或许要花不少时间。
但她相信只要她努力，一切都还来得及。
郁默勋又问：“大概什么时候回来？”
“现在的工作还需要等人交接，恐怕还得等一段时间。”
既然她能回来，再等一段时间又何妨？
两人又聊了一会，郁默勋看了下时间，说：“下面的人给我介绍了一个算法上的天才，据说对方前些天刚回国，我们约了一会见面，既然正好碰上，要不跟我一起去见一见对方？”

容辞摇头：“我对你手下的人也不了解，下次吧。”
郁默勋刚走，容辞就见到封庭深的姐姐封庭琳朝她走了过来。
但她没想到会这么巧的在这里碰到她。
封庭琳没应声，皱眉的看着她：“你怎么会在这里？”
容辞不说，封庭琳都忘记她也是t大毕业的了。
可除了在校师生，今天回校的基本上都是受到学校邀请的荣誉校友。
她容辞一个无名小卒过来凑什么热闹？
只要她不在外面乱说话，丢他们封家的脸，她也懒得说她。
想到这，封庭琳直言来意：“小铭说想吃你做的菜了，晚点我让人送他过去你和庭深那。”
小铭是封庭琳的儿子，比封景心大一两岁。
封庭琳夫妻两感情不和，封庭琳前些年工作忙很少管孩子，他们的孩子这两年越发叛逆，她现在想管却已经很难管得住了。
得知儿子喜欢她煮的菜，封庭琳这两年有空就把人往她和封庭深那送。

> Chapter 5 My wife is on a business trip (Page 1)
Yu Moxun and Rong Ci have indeed rarely seen each other in recent years.
But after only a few meetings, Yu Moxun could see that she was far different from the high-spirited person she was back then.
Thinking of Rong Ci back then, he never dreamed that the word "inferiority" would one day appear on Rong Ci.
Yu Moxun didn't know much about Rong Ci and Feng Tingshen's married life.
He had a guess in his mind, but he didn't say it clearly. He just told her seriously: "It doesn't matter if you fall behind for a while. Your ability and talent are not comparable to ordinary geniuses. Xiao Ci, as long as you still have the heart to follow this path, it is still too late to start over."
"Don't forget, you are the most satisfied student in the teacher's teaching career."
Rong Ci listened and smiled: "If the teacher heard this, I'm afraid he would sneer and say that he was forced to be taller among the short ones."
Thinking of the elegant and sharp-tongued teacher in the past, Rong Ci smiled slightly: "I just saw on the news that the teacher has come back to participate in the celebration. Is he okay?"
"It's good. It's just that our group of students who always embarrass him appear in front of him from time to time, which makes him very bored."
Rong Ci laughed, and couldn't help but remember the days when he was forced to write papers under his mentor every day.
Rong Ci tightened his grip on the tea cup, took a deep breath and nodded: "Okay."
She had given up her ideals for six or seven years because of her love for Feng Tingshen.
She has been away for six or seven years, and it may take a lot of time to catch up.
But she believes that as long as she works hard, everything is still possible.
Yu Moxun asked again: "When will you come back?"
"The current work still needs to be handed over, and I'm afraid it will take some time."
Now that she can come back, why not wait a little longer?
The two chatted for a while, and Yu Moxun checked the time and said, "The people below introduced me to an algorithmic genius. It is said that he just returned to China a few days ago. We made an appointment to meet him. Since we happened to run into him, why don't you come with me to meet him?"
Rong Ci shook his head: "I don't know the people under you either. Let's do it next time."
As soon as Yu Moxun left, Rong Ci saw Feng Tingshen's sister Feng Tinglin walking towards her.
But she didn't expect to meet her here by such a coincidence.
Feng Tinglin didn't respond and looked at her with a frown: "Why are you here?"
Without saying anything, Feng Tinglin had forgotten that she also graduated from T University.
But in addition to current teachers and students, those who returned to school today were basically honorary alumni invited by the school.
Why would she allow a nobody to come over and join in the fun?
As long as she didn't talk nonsense outside and bring shame on their Feng family, she wouldn't bother talking about her.
Thinking of this, Feng Tinglin bluntly stated her purpose: "Xiao Ming said he wants to eat your cooking. I will send him to you and Ting Shen later."
Xiao Ming is Feng Tinglin's son, one or two years older than Feng Jingxin.
Feng Tinglin and her husband were not on good terms with each other. Feng Tinglin was busy with work and rarely took care of her children in the past few years. Their children have become more and more rebellious in the past two years. She wants to take care of them now, but it is already difficult for her to take care of them.
Knowing that her son liked the food she cooked, Feng Tinglin sent food to her and Feng Tingshen when she had time in the past two years.
